summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a 6-K announcing the anticipated launch of a cash tender offer for up to $1,000,000,000 aggregate principal of its $3,000,000,000 6.000% Perpetual Subordinated Contingent Convertible Securities (CUSIP 404280 BL2). The purchase price is 100.50% ($1,005.00 per $1,000 principal) plus accrued interest, with a maximum tender amount of $1 billion. The offer, framed as proactive Tier 1 capital management, expires November 19, 2026, with expected settlement November 24, 2026. Watch for proration if tenders exceed the cap and the capital impact.
